name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes- Uttarakhand
nodalDept: Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand
briefDescription: The Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes- Uttarakhand supports students from the Backward Classes category to continue education after Class 10th. It is managed by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand.
descriptionMd: The Post-Matric Scholarship for Backward Classes- Uttarakhand scheme, initiated by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand, aims to provide crucial support to students from Backward Classes. This initiative helps these students pursue education beyond Class 10th. Its primary goal is to ensure that financial constraints do not hinder their academic aspirations, promoting access to higher education.
benefitsMd:
*   Financial support for post-matriculation education
*   Assistance to continue studies after Class 10th
eligibilityMd:
*   Beneficiaries must belong to the Backward Classes category.
*   Applicants must be continuing their education after Class 10th.
*   The scheme is specific to the state of Uttarakhand.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
